name: Late Chunking
mechanism: Encodes a long document before pooling token representations into bounded chunk embeddings so each chunk vector retains surrounding document context.
use_when: Local chunks lose essential document-level context
avoid_when: Documents exceed the embedding model context limit
The vector infrastructure cannot reproduce token-level pooling and model versions
expected_effects: Contextualized chunk vectors without generated prefixes
Improved retrieval for locally ambiguous passages
failure_modes: Long documents are truncated or inconsistently segmented
Embedding model changes alter every chunk vector
Token pooling implementation mismatches tokenizer boundaries
